outcome.answer: Chenrun Wang appears as an author on LigBench, a unified benchmark for LLM-based research idea generation that aims to provide fine-grained, reliable, and human-aligned evaluation of generated ideas, along with a dataset for pairwise idea judgment [1]. If you meant a benchmark for judging research ideas more broadly, related papers here include novelty judgment, soundness, and falsifiability-focused benchmarks, but only [1] is directly tied to Chenrun Wang.
